card.name: Single digits inside numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that sits inside or ends a longer number, such as an ISBN, a decimal, a dose range or a table number.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: Digits near the end of an ISBN number in a reference list.

modes.label: Dose and range numbers
modes.description: A digit in a dose, concentration or weight range.
modes.example: concentration of 2 to 1<<0>> mg/mL in an infusion bag

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: The digit after the word Table in a table caption.
modes.example: Table <<3>>. Recommended Dosage in Pediatric Patients
